name: print-social-dark-green-smart-home-story-set
title: Dark Smart-Home App Story Set
whatItIs: Three vertical Instagram stories on black: a green-gradient logo tile, a lifestyle photo with headline, and a tilted phone showing climate controls.
whatItMeans: Near-black with a green glow feels calm, modern and eco-smart. Mixing photos, type and UI keeps the set varied.
techniques: Consistent story chrome with progress bars and handle
Green gradient glow rising from the bottom edge
White pill CTA at the story foot
Alternating type, photo and product frames

A soft colored light rising from an edge.
A story that shows the product in use.
